posts.title: NBA Playoffs 2026: Full First Round Predictions
posts.body:
The 2026 NBA Playoffs are here and the first round is packed with fascinating matchups. Here are our full predictions for every series.

Eastern Conference

The Boston Celtics enter as heavy favourites in the East, but the Cleveland Cavaliers have been one of the best teams in the league all season and could cause problems.

Western Conference

Out West, the Oklahoma City Thunder look unstoppable. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has been the best player in the league this season and the Thunder have the depth to go all the way.

posts.title: Former Cal and Michigan Guard Justin Pippen, Son of Scottie Pippen, Commits to Ohio State - Eleven Warriors
posts.body:
Justin Pippen Announces Commitment to Ohio State

In an exciting development for Ohio State basketball, former Cal and Michigan guard Justin Pippen has officially committed to the Buckeyes. The son of NBA legend Scottie Pippen, Justin brings a wealth of talent and experience to a program eager to make a statement in the upcoming season. This announcement marks a pivotal moment for both Pippen and Ohio State as they set their sights on a successful future together.

Expectations for the Buckeyes with Pippen on Board

Pippen's decision to join Ohio State is expected to have a significant impact on the team's dynamics. After a successful stint at both Cal and Michigan, where he showcased his versatility and scoring ability, Buckeyes fans have high expectations for his contributions on the court. As a player whose lineage includes one of the greatest forwards in NBA history, he is poised to make waves in the Big Ten and beyond.

Moreover, Pippen's commitment comes at a crucial time as Ohio State looks to strengthen its roster following the previous season's challenges. With his strong work ethic and basketball IQ, he is likely to be a key player in the Buckeyes' system, providing leadership and skill that could elevate the team's competitive edge.

In sum, Justin Pippen's arrival at Ohio State is not just about continuing a family legacy; it's about carving out his own identity while contributing to a storied basketball program. As fans and analysts eagerly await his debut, the anticipation grows for what promises to be a thrilling season ahead for the Buckeyes in the heart of college basketball.

posts.title: Former Cal and Michigan Guard Justin Pippen, Son of Scottie Pippen, Commits to Ohio State - Eleven Warriors
posts.body:
Justin Pippen Commits to Ohio State

In a significant move for the Ohio State Buckeyes, former Cal and Michigan guard Justin Pippen, son of NBA legend Scottie Pippen, has officially committed to the Buckeyes. This announcement comes as an exciting development for both the team and the fans, who eagerly anticipate Pippen's contributions on the court. With a strong lineage and competitive pedigree, Pippen aims to carry on his family legacy while carving out his own path in college basketball.

A Look at Justin Pippen's Journey

Before joining Ohio State, Justin Pippen had noteworthy stints at both the University of California, Berkeley, and the University of Michigan. His time in college basketball has been marked by impressive performances and an unyielding work ethic—a trait he undoubtedly inherited from his father, a six-time NBA champion. Pippen's decision to join Ohio State reflects not only his ambition but also a commitment to playing at a high level in the Big Ten Conference, known for its intense competition and rich basketball history.

Pippen's skill set as a guard will add depth to Ohio State's backcourt, which is crucial as they prepare for the upcoming season. His ability to score and facilitate plays makes him a valuable asset for head coach Chris Holtmann. With the Buckeyes looking to build on their recent performance in the league, Pippen's arrival is met with optimism from fans and analysts alike, who see him as a potential game-changer.

As the season approaches, all eyes will be on Justin Pippen as he dons the scarlet and gray. With a heavy legacy behind him, he is not just looking to follow in his father's footsteps but also to establish his own legacy at Ohio State. The Buckeyes have added a promising talent, and fans can expect to see exciting basketball as Pippen strives to make a significant impact in his college career.
